blocks.h: 6.1. Subscription plans
flowlift offers a free plan (Starter) and paid plans (Pro+ and Teams), available on a monthly or annual basis according to the options shown on the Platform.
All prices are expressed and charged in Mexican pesos (MXN). The price, billing frequency and features of each plan are those displayed on the Platform before the User completes the purchase.
Applicable taxes, bank fees or currency conversion charges that the User's issuing bank may apply (for example, on foreign cards) are the User's responsibility.
6.2. Promotional pricing

flowlift may offer launch pricing, limited-time discounts or specific promotions. Such prices are subject to availability and validity periods, and apply only under the conditions displayed at the time of purchase.

Unless otherwise stated, the subscription renews at the contracted price. Any change to the renewal price will be notified to the User with reasonable advance notice, and the User may cancel before the renewal date if they do not agree.
6.3. Free trial eligibility
flowlift offers a fourteen (14) calendar day free trial for the Pro+ and Teams plans. No credit or debit card is required to start the trial.

The free trial is limited to one trial per Business, account or owner, according to the identification criteria flowlift reasonably determines. The trial may not be repeated by creating additional accounts, changing email addresses, changing owners, changing plans or by any other means intended to obtain an additional trial.
flowlift reserves the right to determine eligibility and to refuse, cancel or limit a free trial where it reasonably believes the promotion is being abused or these Terms are being breached.
6.4. Trial start and duration
The trial begins when flowlift activates the User's trial subscription and lasts fourteen (14) calendar days, unless the Platform expressly indicates a different period.

The trial end date and time, and the applicable time zone, are those shown on the Platform or in communications sent to the User. The trial will not be extended due to non-use, service interruptions, public holidays, plan changes or any other circumstance, unless flowlift expressly confirms otherwise in writing.
6.5. No charge during the trial
No charge is made during the trial period.
Before the trial ends, flowlift will send the User a reminder stating the end date and the steps needed to continue using the paid plan's features.
6.6. Conversion to a paid plan

If the User adds and maintains a valid payment method before the trial ends, the subscription may convert automatically into a paid subscription at the end of the trial period. At that point, flowlift or its payment provider may charge the price corresponding to the selected plan, at the frequency chosen by the User.
The User is responsible for reviewing the price, frequency, payment method and charge start date before adding a payment method or continuing with the subscription.
6.7. If the User does not add a payment method
If the trial ends and the User has not added a valid payment method, no charge will be made.

In that case, the paid subscription will be paused and the account will automatically move to the free Starter plan. The plan change will limit access to certain paid features, but the Business's data and its bookings will be retained, unless the account is deleted in accordance with these Terms.

The User may regain access to the paid plan by adding a valid payment method and following the instructions available on the Platform, subject to plan availability and the conditions in force at that time.
6.8. Cancellation
The User may cancel their subscription from the Platform or through the contact channels indicated by flowlift.
Cancelling during the free trial will prevent conversion to a paid subscription, provided it is completed before the trial period ends.
Cancelling a paid subscription will prevent future renewals. The User will retain access to the plan's features until the end of the period already paid for.
The User should keep the cancellation confirmation and verify that the cancellation was processed correctly.
6.9. Automatic renewal
Paid card subscriptions renew automatically for successive periods of the same length (monthly or annual, as applicable), unless the User cancels before the renewal date.
6.10. Cash payments through OXXO
flowlift may offer quarterly bundles payable in cash at OXXO stores. These payments have the following particular characteristics:

items: They are one-time payments granting access to the selected plan for a three (3) month period. They do not renew automatically.
Payment confirmation is not immediate: it may take until the next business day to be reflected. Access to the paid plan is activated only once the payment is confirmed by the payment provider.
The payment voucher has an expiration date. If it is not paid within that period, the order is cancelled at no cost and the plan is not activated.
At the end of the three-month period, the account will automatically move to the free Starter plan unless the User purchases again.
Unless applicable law provides otherwise, payments made through OXXO are non-refundable once the corresponding period has been activated.

blocks.h: 6.11. Failed payments
If a charge is declined, overdue, reversed or cannot be processed, flowlift may retry it and may suspend, pause, limit or cancel access to paid features until the situation is resolved.
The User must keep their billing details and payment method up to date.
6.12. Refunds
Unless applicable law, a specific promotion or flowlift expressly states otherwise, payments for subscription periods already started are non-refundable.
Any approved refund will be issued to the original payment method where technically possible. Bank fees, currency conversion charges or costs charged by third parties may not be recoverable.
6.13. Plan changes
The User may change plans where the Platform allows it:

items: Upgrades: take effect immediately, with the charge prorated against the current period.
Downgrades: the User keeps their current plan until the end of the paid billing cycle, after which the lower plan applies.

blocks.h: The User is not entitled to a new free trial by changing plans or by subscribing again after having used the initial trial.

The free trial is not a permanent offer. flowlift may modify, suspend or withdraw the promotion for new Users. Any trial already started will continue under the conditions displayed at the time of activation, unless a change is required for legal, security, fraud or Service operation reasons.
6.15. Tax invoicing (CFDI)

Users requiring a Mexican digital tax invoice (CFDI) must request it through the contact channels indicated in these Terms, providing complete tax details, within the calendar month in which the payment was made. flowlift is not obliged to issue a CFDI for prior periods once the corresponding tax month has closed.

blocks.h: 9.1. Applicable legal framework

flowlift processes personal data in accordance with the Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties in force in Mexico, published in the Official Gazette of the Federation on March 20, 2025, its regulations and other applicable provisions. The competent authority is the Ministry of Anti-Corruption and Good Governance (Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno).
9.2. User data
With respect to the personal data of the User (account holder), flowlift acts as data controller and processes it in accordance with the Privacy Notice available on the Platform.
9.3. End customer data
With respect to the personal data of end customers that the Business collects, stores or manages through the Platform, the Business acts as controller and flowlift acts as processor.

This data includes: name, email address, telephone number, private notes added by the Business, and booking history (date, service, price and status). The customer directory also generates derived information from that history, such as number of visits, total amount spent, no-shows, last visit, most frequent service and a customer behavior label. The Business acknowledges that this derived information constitutes processing of personal data under its responsibility and must be reflected in its own privacy notice.
9.4. flowlift's obligations as processor
As processor, flowlift undertakes to:

items: Process personal data only in accordance with the Business's instructions and to provide the Service
Refrain from processing personal data for its own purposes other than those set out in these Terms
Implement reasonable administrative, technical and physical security measures
Maintain confidentiality regarding the personal data processed
Not transfer personal data to third parties, except to the sub-processors listed in clause 9.6, on the Business's instruction, or where required by a competent authority
Delete or return personal data upon termination of the contractual relationship, in accordance with clause 11

blocks.h: 9.5. The Business's obligations as controller
The Business warrants that it:

items: Has a legal basis and, where applicable, the necessary consent to collect and process its end customers' data
Makes its own privacy notice available to its end customers where required by law
Will directly handle data subject rights requests (access, rectification, cancellation and objection) received from its end customers

blocks.h: 9.5.bis. Available data subject rights tooling
flowlift makes tools available to the Business within the Platform to export, rectify and delete its end customers' information.

The User acknowledges that the delete function works as follows: identifiable customer data (name, email, telephone and notes) is removed, previously issued access links are revoked, and an anonymized historical record of bookings is retained (date, service, price and status) that no longer allows identification of the customer. That anonymized record is kept for the Business's own operational, accounting and statistical purposes.
9.6. Sub-processors and infrastructure

The Service relies on third-party infrastructure and service providers that may host or process information, including: Replit (application and database hosting), Stripe (payment processing), Resend (transactional email) and authentication providers such as Google and Microsoft. flowlift may update this list, maintaining equivalent data protection obligations with each provider, and will notify the User of new providers that process its end customers' data.
9.7. International transfers
The User acknowledges that some of these providers may store or process information outside Mexican territory, and authorizes such transfers to the extent necessary to provide the Service.
9.8. Security incidents

In the event of a security breach significantly affecting personal data processed on the Business's behalf, flowlift will notify the User without undue delay, with the information reasonably available.
